ITEM 1 | Pinkish-red meat slices with a dark herb or spice crust on the outer edge, moist and slightly glossy, arranged as a stacked pile about 5 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, sitting upper right of the plate with a small sprig of green garnish on top | 70
ITEM 2 | Small dark maroon-red oval beans, smooth glossy skins, whole and uniform, about 1 to 1.5 cm long, clustered in a loose mound covering roughly 15 percent of the plate's left-center area, with a few thin pinkish-white onion slivers and a pale green herb sprig beneath | 60
ITEM 3 | Creamy off-white pale spread with a soft, slightly grainy, moist texture, spread in a wedge about 6 cm long and 3 cm wide, partly covered by a golden-brown seared pastry or bread layer on one edge, with a few small green herb leaves and a red-purple leaf garnish on top | 55
ITEM 4 | Thin pale green herb sprigs and small leaves scattered across the meat and beans, dry and slightly wilted, a few leaves total | 3
